B: Magnitude through the B (blue) filter, in the color index B − V
B_lambda: Blackbody spectrum per unit wavelength (Planck's law)
C: Constant of the color index, fixed so that Vega has B − V = 0
T: Temperature of the blackbody (the star's surface)
V: Magnitude through the V (visual, yellow green) filter
e: Euler's number, the base of natural logarithms
lambda_B: One wavelength standing for the whole B filter, about 440 nm
lambda_V: One wavelength standing for the whole V filter, about 550 nm
